name: Ink Lens on a region of the active segment
description: Chase Hendrick's Ink Lens (spaces/ink-lens/inklens.py run --local) on one region of the active segment: an openly licensed 9 um ink model in both depth orders, keeping only ink above the region's own reverse-depth control. Ink Lens writes the overlay, the pins and a merged ink-detections.json into the segment folder itself; reselect the segment to see the new record. Exit 3 (no ink above the control) shows as a failed run. Model output, not a reading.
